entries.summary: Empty-host bootstrap, individual application installation and explicitly compatible managed updates
Pinned supervisor updates Web/manager while retaining authentication, settings and history
Persistent scoped MCP credentials with revocation, rotation and owner authority invalidation
Secret-free effect timelines and recorded deployment layout through read-only MCP, with private offline exports
External prerequisites, application distribution catalogs, real-host acceptance and pinned supervisor maintenance are separate work

recovery_conditions: Preserve control journals, authentication and diagnostic evidence. Unknown effects stop without replay. When Updater is unavailable, use an independent administrator channel for human recovery; inspect queued Jobs before service restart.
